senses.gloss: (interch. with <cite ref="Q00397"><he>פּוּשׁ</he></cite> a. <cite ref="Q02067"><he>פְּשֵׁי</he></cite>, q. v.)
[to be blown up,] to be large; to increase.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 1:7">Targ. Ex. I, 7</cite>; a. e. Imper. <cite ref="Q00397"><he>פּוּשׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 1:28">Targ. Gen. I, 28</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 121a">B. Bath. 121ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Nedarim 78a:10">Ned. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>אתא לנהרדעא</he> … <he>נ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ולא אשכחיה</he>) he came to N. to see R. S.; he was gone.

senses.gloss: (interch. with אָפֵישׁ, a. אַפְשֵׁי) to extend, enlarge.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 19:6">Targ. Y. Num. XIX, 6</cite> <he>אַפּוּשֵׁי</he>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Menachot 23b:20">Men. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>דא׳ לה תבלין טפי וכ׳</he> when he made the quantity of spices larger than &c.
<cite ref="Beitzah 7a:12">Bets. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>אַפּוּשֵׁי … לא מַפְּשִׁינָן</he> (or <he>אֲפוּשֵׁי … מַפְשִׁי׳</he>) we must not extend the range of unclean things by rabbinical enactments.
<cite ref="Sotah 26a:9">Sot. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>אפושי … לא לִיפַּשׁ</he> we ought not to increase the number of illegitimate births (by allowing intermarriage between bastards).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 12b">B. Bath. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>בעינא דא׳ אריסי</he> (Rashi <he>ניחא לי לאפושי</he>) I desire (it is an advantage to me) to have a large number of tenants around me (whom my neighbor must employ).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 12b:14">Ib.</cite> <he>אפושי לאו מילתא היא</he> this plea about a large number &c., is no plea; a. e.—Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ top; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ top <he>נַפֵּישׁ לר׳ וכ׳</he> let us make room for R. H.
